tags.name: Manufacturer
tags.documentation: Cell builder (integrator).

tags.name: ManufacturerUri
tags.documentation: URI of the manufacturer.

tags.name: Model
tags.documentation: Model name.

tags.name: ProductCode
tags.documentation: Manufacturer product code.

tags.name: SerialNumber
tags.documentation: Serial number of the cell.

tags.name: ProductInstanceUri
tags.documentation: Globally unique instance URI.

tags.name: HardwareRevision
tags.documentation: Hardware revision.

tags.name: SoftwareRevision
tags.documentation: Cell controller program revision (bump when the simulation logic changes).

tags.name: YearOfConstruction
tags.documentation: Year of construction.

tags.name: MonthOfConstruction
tags.documentation: Month of construction (1-12).

tags.name: AssetId
tags.documentation: Customer asset id (ISA-95 site-area-cell).

tags.name: ComponentName
tags.documentation: Customer-facing name.

tags.name: Location
tags.documentation: Site/area/bay.

tags.name: StateCurrent
tags.documentation: Current PackML state number.

tags.name: StateCurrentName
tags.documentation: Name of the current PackML state (English, as in the PackMLState table).

tags.name: UnitModeCurrent
tags.documentation: Current unit mode.

tags.name: UnitModeCurrentName
tags.documentation: Name of the current unit mode.

tags.name: MachSpeed
tags.documentation: Effective speed setpoint: C01.Command.MachSpeed clamped to [0.1, 1.0] x C01.Admin.MachDesignSpeed.

tags.name: CurMachSpeed
tags.documentation: Actual rate: 60 / mean interval of the last 5 robot placements; 0 outside Execute or if no placement for 15 s.

tags.name: EquipmentStarved
tags.documentation: True when the robot has waited for a part > 3.0 s, CV01 is empty and the order still needs parts.

tags.name: EquipmentBlocked
tags.documentation: True when the robot has waited for a free place position on CV02 > 3.0 s.

tags.name: MachineryItemState
tags.documentation: OPC 40001-1 item state derived from the PackML state (mapping in scenario.md).

tags.name: MachineryOperationMode
tags.documentation: OPC 40001-1 operation mode derived from the unit mode.

tags.name: Heartbeat
tags.documentation: Increments by 1 every second (wraps at 2^32). Used by Ignition to detect a frozen controller.

tags.name: PacDateTime
tags.documentation: Controller clock (UTC), updated every second.

tags.name: CntrlCmd
tags.documentation: PackML state command. Write a non-zero value; the PLC executes or refuses it within one scan (100 ms), writes C01.Command.CmdResult, increments C01.Command.CmdCounter, then writes 0 back.

tags.name: UnitModeRequest
tags.documentation: Unit mode request (1 Production, 2 Maintenance). Same handshake as CntrlCmd. Accepted only in Stopped, Idle, Complete or Aborted.

tags.name: MachSpeed
tags.documentation: Requested speed. The PLC clamps it (see C01.Status.MachSpeed) and maps it to RB01 speed override.

tags.name: CmdResult
tags.documentation: Result of the last command (CntrlCmd or UnitModeRequest) processed.

tags.name: CmdCounter
tags.documentation: Incremented each time a command is processed (accepted or refused). Lets the HMI match a result to its write.

tags.name: ProdProcessedCount
tags.documentation: Parts finished by the cell since controller start: one per C01.Traceability record (good, reject or scrapped). Restarts at 0 when the controller restarts.

tags.name: ProdDefectiveCount
tags.documentation: Records with Result Reject or Scrapped since controller start.

tags.name: ProdConsumedCount
tags.documentation: Parts released by upstream onto CV01 since controller start.

tags.name: StopReason
tags.documentation: First-out cause of the last transition into Stopping, Holding, Suspending, Aborting or Completing. Kept until the next such transition; reset to 0 when Execute is re-entered.

tags.name: StopReasonText
tags.documentation: English text of C01.Admin.StopReason.

tags.name: StateCurrentTime
tags.documentation: Time spent in the current state.

tags.name: AccTimeSinceReset
tags.documentation: Time since controller start.

tags.name: MachDesignSpeed
tags.documentation: Design rate of the active part type = 60 / C01.Order.Active.IdealCycleTime; 25.0 when no order.

tags.name: StartUpTime
tags.documentation: UTC time the controller (simulation) started. A change tells the MES that counters restarted.

tags.name: OrderId
tags.documentation: Order id to load (1-32 printable ASCII characters).

tags.name: PartType
tags.documentation: Part type to produce (recipe number).

tags.name: TargetQuantity
tags.documentation: Number of GOOD parts to produce.

tags.name: LoadRequest
tags.documentation: Set true after writing the three fields above. The PLC evaluates on the rising edge, writes C01.Order.Request.LoadResult and resets this to false.

tags.name: LoadResult
tags.documentation: Result of the last load request.

tags.name: OrderId
tags.documentation: Active order id (empty = no order).

tags.name: PartType
tags.documentation: Active part type.

tags.name: ProductCode
tags.documentation: Product code of the active part type (from the cell recipe table).

tags.name: TargetQuantity
tags.documentation: Target good quantity.

tags.name: GoodCount
tags.documentation: Good parts of the active order.

tags.name: RejectCount
tags.documentation: Reject + scrapped parts of the active order.

tags.name: RemainingQuantity
tags.documentation: max(0, TargetQuantity - GoodCount).

tags.name: OrderStatus
tags.documentation: Status of the active order inside the cell.

tags.name: NominalDiameter
tags.documentation: Nominal bore diameter of the active part type.

tags.name: LowerLimit
tags.documentation: Lower acceptance limit = nominal - tolerance.

tags.name: UpperLimit
tags.documentation: Upper acceptance limit = nominal + tolerance.

tags.name: IdealCycleTime
tags.documentation: Ideal cycle time of the active part type at 100 % speed (used for OEE performance).

tags.name: StartTime
tags.documentation: UTC time Execute was first entered for this order.

tags.name: EndTime
tags.documentation: UTC time the order reached Complete.

tags.name: Sequence
tags.documentation: Record number, +1 per record from 1 at controller start. 0 = no record presented yet.

tags.name: PartId
tags.documentation: Part serial read from the part DataMatrix, format P + 9 digits (e.g. P027345601); NOREAD when unreadable (phase 2).

tags.name: OrderId
tags.documentation: Order the part was produced for.

tags.name: PartType
tags.documentation: Part type.

tags.name: MeasuredDiameter
tags.documentation: Measured bore diameter (0.0 when not measured).

tags.name: Result
tags.documentation: Part result.

tags.name: DefectCode
tags.documentation: Defect code (0 when good).

tags.name: Timestamp
tags.documentation: UTC time the part was finished (placed, dropped or purged).

tags.name: DataReady
tags.documentation: True when the record fields above hold an unacknowledged record. Fields are written one scan before DataReady goes true.

tags.name: AckSequence
tags.documentation: MES writes the Sequence it has stored. When equal to Sequence the PLC drops DataReady and presents the next record one scan later.

tags.name: BufferCount
tags.documentation: Records waiting, including the presented one.

tags.name: LostCount
tags.documentation: Records discarded because the 200-record buffer was full (oldest dropped first).

tags.name: EStopActive
tags.documentation: Emergency stop circuit open (SF01.Status.EStopOk false). Alarm code 101.

tags.name: GuardDoorOpen
tags.documentation: Guard door opened while the robot was in automatic. Alarm code 103.

tags.name: VacuumLoss
tags.documentation: Vacuum lost while transferring a part (part dropped). Alarm code 110.

tags.name: PickFailed
tags.documentation: Two consecutive pick attempts failed to build vacuum. Alarm code 111.

tags.name: InfeedJam
tags.documentation: CV01 runs but no part reached the pick position within the jam timeout. Alarm code 120.

tags.name: InfeedDriveFault
tags.documentation: CV01 drive tripped (CV01.Status.DriveFault). Alarm code 121.

tags.name: OutfeedDriveFault
tags.documentation: CV02 drive tripped (CV02.Status.DriveFault). Alarm code 122.

tags.name: QualityNoResult
tags.documentation: QS01 returned no result within 2.0 s of the trigger. Alarm code 130.

tags.name: PartIdUnreadable
tags.documentation: Three consecutive parts with an unreadable DataMatrix. Alarm code 131.

tags.name: PartSensorStuck
tags.documentation: CV01.Sensors.PartAtPick still on 1.0 s after a successful pick. Alarm code 140.

tags.name: AirPressureLow
tags.documentation: Compressed air below 5.5 bar (UT01.Status.AirPressureOk false). Alarm code 150.

tags.name: RobotCommFault
tags.documentation: RB01.Status.Heartbeat unchanged for more than 2.5 s. Alarm code 160.

tags.name: RejectRateHigh
tags.documentation: Warning: 5 or more non-good parts among the last 50 (no state change). Alarm code 170.

tags.name: RejectBinNearFull
tags.documentation: Warning: RJ01.Status.NearFull. Alarm code 21.

tags.name: RejectBinFull
tags.documentation: RJ01.Status.Full: the cell holds until the bin is emptied. Alarm code 20.

tags.name: Manufacturer
tags.documentation: Manufacturer of the camera.

tags.name: Model
tags.documentation: Model of the camera.

tags.name: SerialNumber
tags.documentation: SerialNumber of the camera.

tags.name: Ready
tags.documentation: Camera healthy and not busy.

tags.name: Busy
tags.documentation: Inspection in progress (0.4 s per part).

tags.name: CameraOk
tags.documentation: False while Sim.Faults.CameraNoResult is active.

tags.name: InspectionCount
tags.documentation: Inspections since controller start.

tags.name: LastPartId
tags.documentation: Part id read at the last inspection (empty if unreadable).

tags.name: LastMeasurement
tags.documentation: Last measured bore diameter.

tags.name: LastResult
tags.documentation: Last inspection result.

tags.name: Manufacturer
tags.documentation: Manufacturer of the robot.

tags.name: Model
tags.documentation: Model of the robot.

tags.name: ProductCode
tags.documentation: ProductCode of the robot.

tags.name: SerialNumber
tags.documentation: SerialNumber of the robot.

tags.name: SoftwareRevision
tags.documentation: SoftwareRevision of the robot.

tags.name: YearOfConstruction
tags.documentation: YearOfConstruction of the robot.

tags.name: MotionDeviceCategory
tags.documentation: Robot kinematics category.

tags.name: SpeedOverride
tags.documentation: Speed override applied to motion steps = clamp(100 x C01.Status.MachSpeed / C01.Admin.MachDesignSpeed, 10, 100).

tags.name: OnPath
tags.documentation: True while the arm is executing a motion step.

tags.name: InControl
tags.documentation: Servos on and controlled (see robot state table in scenario.md).

tags.name: ActualPosition
tags.documentation: Shoulder rotation. Linear interpolation between taught points (scenario.md).

tags.name: ActualPosition
tags.documentation: Elbow rotation. Linear interpolation between taught points (scenario.md).

tags.name: ActualPosition
tags.documentation: Quill stroke, 0 = top, positive downwards. Linear interpolation between taught points (scenario.md).

tags.name: ActualPosition
tags.documentation: Tool rotation. Linear interpolation between taught points (scenario.md).

tags.name: StartUpTime
tags.documentation: UTC time the robot controller started.

tags.name: TaskProgramName
tags.documentation: Loaded robot program (per part type, see PartType table); empty when none.

tags.name: TaskProgramLoaded
tags.documentation: True once an order has been loaded into the cell.

tags.name: ExecutionMode
tags.documentation: Program execution mode (always CONTINUOUS in this cell).

tags.name: OperationalMode
tags.documentation: Robot operational mode (AUTOMATIC_EXTERNAL: program driven by the cell controller).

tags.name: EmergencyStop
tags.documentation: True while the e-stop chain is open.

tags.name: ProtectiveStop
tags.documentation: True while a protective stop is active (guard door open in automatic).

tags.name: Heartbeat
tags.documentation: Increments by 1 every second; watched by the cell (RobotCommFault).

tags.name: Homed
tags.documentation: True after homing in Resetting; false after Aborting.

tags.name: CycleStep
tags.documentation: Current step of the pick-and-place cycle.

tags.name: CycleStepName
tags.documentation: Name of the current step.

tags.name: AtHome
tags.documentation: Arm at the WaitAbovePick taught point.

tags.name: PartInGripper
tags.documentation: A part is held by the gripper.

tags.name: Destination
tags.documentation: Where the held part goes.

tags.name: VacuumOn
tags.documentation: Vacuum valve commanded on.

tags.name: VacuumOk
tags.documentation: Vacuum switch: RB01.Status.VacuumLevel <= -60 kPa.

tags.name: VacuumLevel
tags.documentation: Gripper vacuum (gauge, negative = vacuum).

tags.name: CycleCount
tags.documentation: Completed pick-and-place cycles since controller start.

tags.name: LastCycleTime
tags.documentation: Duration of the last cycle, MoveToPick start to ReturnToWait end, waits included.

tags.name: JogForward
tags.documentation: Maintenance mode only (and state Stopped or Idle): CV01 runs at its setpoint while true.

tags.name: DriveReset
tags.documentation: Pulse: reset a CV01 drive fault. The PLC writes it back to false after one scan.

tags.name: Running
tags.documentation: CV01 belt running.

tags.name: DriveFault
tags.documentation: CV01 drive tripped (see CV01.Status.DriveFaultCode).

tags.name: ActualSpeed
tags.documentation: Belt speed: setpoint when running, 0 when stopped (no ramp).

tags.name: MotorCurrent
tags.documentation: Motor current: 1.20 A running, 2.60 A when jammed, 0 stopped.

tags.name: DriveFaultCode
tags.documentation: Drive fault code.

tags.name: PartsOnConveyor
tags.documentation: Parts on CV01 including the one at the pick position.

tags.name: EntryOccupied
tags.documentation: Photo-eye at CV01 entry: a part occupies the first 100 mm.

tags.name: PartAtPick
tags.documentation: Photo-eye at the CV01 end stop: a part is at the pick position.

tags.name: SpeedSetpoint
tags.documentation: CV01 belt speed setpoint. Out-of-range writes are clamped.

tags.name: JogForward
tags.documentation: Maintenance mode only (and state Stopped or Idle): CV02 runs at its setpoint while true.

tags.name: DriveReset
tags.documentation: Pulse: reset a CV02 drive fault. The PLC writes it back to false after one scan.

tags.name: Running
tags.documentation: CV02 belt running.

tags.name: DriveFault
tags.documentation: CV02 drive tripped (see CV02.Status.DriveFaultCode).

tags.name: ActualSpeed
tags.documentation: Belt speed: setpoint when running, 0 when stopped (no ramp).

tags.name: MotorCurrent
tags.documentation: Motor current: 1.10 A running, 0 stopped.

tags.name: DriveFaultCode
tags.documentation: Drive fault code.

tags.name: PartsOnConveyor
tags.documentation: Parts on CV02.

tags.name: EntryOccupied
tags.documentation: Photo-eye at the CV02 place zone: a part rear edge is within the first 150 mm.

tags.name: ExitPE
tags.documentation: Photo-eye at the CV02 exit: a part front is within the last 100 mm.

tags.name: SpeedSetpoint
tags.documentation: CV02 belt speed setpoint. Out-of-range writes are clamped.

tags.name: BinEmptied
tags.documentation: Pulse: operator confirms the reject bin was emptied; RJ01.Status.Count is set to 0. PLC writes it back to false.

tags.name: NearFull
tags.documentation: RJ01.Status.Count >= RJ01.Parameters.NearFullLevel.

tags.name: Full
tags.documentation: RJ01.Status.Count >= RJ01.Parameters.Capacity.

tags.name: Count
tags.documentation: Parts in the reject bin (may exceed Capacity by 1, see scenario.md).

tags.name: Capacity
tags.documentation: Reject bin capacity (Full threshold).

tags.name: NearFullLevel
tags.documentation: NearFull threshold; clamped to Capacity - 1.

tags.name: EStopOk
tags.documentation: E-stop chain closed (fail-safe: true = healthy).

tags.name: GuardDoorClosed
tags.documentation: Guard door closed.

tags.name: SafetyOk
tags.documentation: Safety relay output: e-stop OK, door closed and safety reset done.

tags.name: AirPressureOk
tags.documentation: UT01.Status.AirPressure >= 5.5 bar.

tags.name: AirPressure
tags.documentation: Compressed air supply pressure (6.20 bar nominal).

tags.name: ActivePower
tags.documentation: Cell active power from the energy meter (model in scenario.md).

tags.name: EnergyTotal
tags.documentation: Energy counter since controller start, UInt32 in Wh, high word first (Ignition default word order).

tags.name: Heartbeat
tags.documentation: I/O coupler heartbeat: +1 every 100 ms scan, wraps at 65535.

tags.name: AutoRun
tags.documentation: Lab autopilot drives this cell (labsim.autopilot): dispatch, start, reset, empty the reject bin. Set false to drive the cell by hand (HMI, smoke test).

tags.name: Tick
tags.documentation: Changes every second; its value-changed script runs the cell's MES cycle (mes.cell.tick).
